traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The angel makes three Soul Scythe attacks.

actions.name: Soul Scythe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic or Radiant damage (angel's choice). If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target dies, and its soul is trapped in the angel's scythe. The target can't be raised from the dead until the angel is destroyed, releasing all souls trapped in the scythe.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18).

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]] (24-hour duration), [[Tools/Spells/Locate Creature|Locate Creature]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Circle Of Death|Circle of Death]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|Plane Shift]], [[Tools/Spells/Power Word Kill|Power Word Kill]]

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step
bonus_actions.desc: The angel casts [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|Misty Step]], requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The angel makes two attacks, using Bite, Spear, or Radiant Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the angel.

actions.name: Radiant Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 60 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Radiant damage, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Overwhelming Presence (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15, each enemy in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the angel can see within 120 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Prone and Stunned conditions until the end of the angel's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]] (24-hour duration), [[Tools/Spells/Locate Creature|Locate Creature]]

bonus_actions.name: Warding Bond (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The angel can choose one creature it can see within 30 feet to become its ward. The target becomes the angel's ward until it dies or until the angel uses this Bonus Action to choose a different ward. While the angel is within 10 feet of this ward, the ward gains a +4 bonus to saving throws.

reactions.name: Warding Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: The angel's ward is targeted by a melee or ranged attack while within 10 feet of the angel. Response: The ward adds 4 to its AC, and the angel makes a Spear attack against the triggering attacker if it is within reach.

sb.name: Angel of Slaughter
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.desc: If the angel fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The angel makes two Engulfing Slam attacks and uses Fling.

actions.name: Engulfing Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Radiant damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is pulled into the angel's space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. When the angel moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The angel can have up to three creatures Grappled by this action at a time.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: The angel throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space the angel can see within 30 feet of itself that isn't in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 17 (5d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Shapechange|Shapechange]] (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Control Weather|Control Weather]], [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|Plane Shift]]

legendary_actions.name: Fling
legendary_actions.desc: The angel uses Fling. The angel can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Spin and Slam
legendary_actions.desc: The angel moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Engulfing Slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Whirlwind of Death
legendary_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the angel. Failure: 33 (6d10) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of the angel's next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The angel can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3 (4 in its lair). One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The angel has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The angel makes three Ring attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Unblinking Eye.

actions.name: Ring
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of five rings, and while Grappled, it has the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Cone of Retribution (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each enemy in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Radiant damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Unblinking Eye
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Grappled by the angel. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Shapechange|Shapechange]] (Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell), [[Tools/Spells/Locate Creature|Locate Creature]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|Plane Shift]]

traits.name: Desperate Attacks
traits.desc: The bondbeast has Advantage on attack rolls if its bonded spellcaster is within 10 feet and is Bloodied.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bondbeast makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the bondbeast's next turn. While Poisoned in this way, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects originating from the bondbeast's bonded spellcaster, and spell attack rolls made against the Poisoned target by the bonded spellcaster have Advantage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The bondbeast takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reactions.name: Deflection
reactions.desc: Trigger: An attack roll hits the bondbeast's bonded spellcaster while the bonded spellcaster is within 10 feet of the bondbeast. Response: Reduce the triggering attack's damage by 8 (1d10 + 3).

sb.name: Dread Linnorm
sb.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the linnorm fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The linnorm has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The linnorm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dread linnorm makes one Bite attack and two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) damage of a type chosen by the linnorm: Cold or Fire. If the target is a creature, it gains 1 Exhaustion level, and the linnorm regains 5 (1d10) Hit Points. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it automatically fails its saving throws against the linnorm's Twin Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Twin Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 27 (5d10) Cold damage and 27 (5d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Slithering Strike
legendary_actions.desc: The linnorm moves up to half its speed and uses Bite.

legendary_actions.name: Stone Wall
legendary_actions.desc: The linnorm casts [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Stone|Wall of Stone]], requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (DC 18). The linnorm can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Sweep
legendary_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature of the linnorm's choice in a 5-foot Emanation. Failure: 17 (2d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3 (4 in its lair). One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Fire Aura (Fire Form Only)
traits.desc: At the end of each of the firre's turns, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the firre takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Flammable objects in the Emanation start burning.

actions.name: Multiattack (Eladrin Form Only)
actions.desc: The firre makes a Burning Blade attack and uses Flaming Gaze.

actions.name: Burning Blade (Eladrin Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Flaming Gaze
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the firre can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (2d6 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the firre's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.desc: The firre shape-shifts into a Medium column of fire (Speed 50 ft.), or it returns to its eladrin form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Anything it is wearing transforms with it. While in fire form, the firre can't manipulate objects.

sb.name: Gore Drinker
sb.languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The gore drinker has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the gore drinker fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The gore drinker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gore drinker makes two attacks, using Greatclub or Slam in any combination.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. The gore drinker can grapple up to three creatures at a time with its corpse parts.

actions.name: Bilious Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 27 (6d8) Acid damage, and the target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the end of the gore drinker's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

legendary_actions.name: Dodge and Strike
legendary_actions.desc: The gore drinker moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and makes one Greatclub or Slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Drink Blood
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, one creature Grappled by the gore drinker. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the gore drinker regains Hit Points equal to that amount. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The gore drinker can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fling
legendary_actions.desc: The gore drinker throws a Medium or smaller creature it has Grappled to a space on the ground that the gore drinker can see within 30 feet of itself. Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Failure or Success: The gore drinker can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.desc: If the elemental takes Fire damage, its Piercing Form trait doesn't function on its next turn, and it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Piercing Form
traits.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the elemental deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to any creature with 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two Ice Claw attacks.

actions.name: Ice Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Shard Spray (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 11 (2d10) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage, and the creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

sb.name: Mageguard Sphere
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The mageguard sphere has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.desc: A spellcaster bonded to the mageguard sphere can cause it to store one spell of level 2 or lower. To do so, the bonded spellcaster must cast the spell on the sphere while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the sphere. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The sphere can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mageguard sphere makes two Force Burst attacks.

actions.name: Force Burst
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Force damage.

reactions.name: Magical Redirection
reactions.desc: Trigger: A spell or other magical effect targets the bonded spellcaster while the bonded spellcaster is within 10 feet of the mageguard sphere. Response: The mageguard sphere becomes the target instead. If the redirected spell or magical effect used a spell slot, the mageguard sphere also regains 1 Hit Point per spell slot.

sb.name: Magiplasm
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, deafened, exhaustion, grappled, prone, restrained
sb.languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The magiplasm can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The magiplasm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The magiplasm makes two Slam attacks and uses Smother.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Smother
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target takes 22 (5d8) Acid damage and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 9 (1d8 + 5) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The magiplasm can only smother one creature at a time.

reactions.name: Transfer Magic
reactions.desc: Trigger: The magiplasm is smothering a creature and takes damage from a spell of level 5 or lower or a magical effect. Response: The engulfed target takes the same amount of damage and the magiplasm reduces the damage it takes from the triggering spell or magical effect to 0.

traits.name: Earth Passage

actions.name: Burning Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the elemental can see within 120 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The mirror haunt can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. If a creature within 30 feet of it takes a Utilize action to show the mirror haunt the haunt's own reflection, this trait is suppressed for 1 minute.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The mirror haunt has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mirror haunt makes two Mind Slash attacks.

actions.name: Mind Slash
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Mirror Step (1/Day)
actions.desc: The mirror haunt turns a normal mirror into a portal between its current location and a similar location on the Feywild, the Material Plane, or the Shadowfell. The portal remains open for 1 minute, and the portal's destination is visible through it.

bonus_actions.name: Twisted Reflection (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 16, up to two creatures the mirror haunt can see within 30 feet of itself. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the mirror haunt's next turn. If the mirror haunt is within 30 feet of a portal created with its Mirror Step, it can also teleport the target to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet of the other side of the portal. Success: Half damage only.

sb.name: Mud Elemental
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Aversion to Cold and Fire
traits.desc: If the elemental takes Cold or Fire damage, its Speed becomes 0, and it can't use Engulf until the end of its next turn. However, a creature Grappled by the elemental has Disadvantage on ability checks made to escape the grapple during that time as well.

traits.name: Mud Form
traits.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot without expending extra movement to do so.

When the elemental moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The elemental can have up to two creatures Grappled by this Bonus Action at a time.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The sarcopike can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

sb.name: Smoke Elemental
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Aversion to Wind
traits.desc: If the elemental starts its turn within a strong wind (such as one created by the [[Tools/Spells/Gust Of Wind|Gust of Wind]] spell), it makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the elemental has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its turn.

traits.name: Smoke Form
traits.desc: The elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two Smoky Tendril attacks.

actions.name: Smoky Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 15 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Asphyxiate (Recharge 4–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature in the elemental's space. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. All Exhaustion levels gained from this Bonus Action are removed after 1 minute.

traits.desc: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Merge
traits.desc: The ooze and one other Sovereign Ooze Vassal within 5 feet of it merge over the course of a Short Rest. When both oozes finish the Short Rest, they merge into a Sovereign Ooze Lord.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ooze makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Arcane Glob (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the ooze can see within 90 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Force damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

reactions.name: Damage Dispersal
reactions.desc: Trigger: The ooze takes damage from a spell or magical effect. Response: The sovereign ooze halves the damage it takes (round down), and each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the ooze takes 10 (3d6) Force damage.

sb.name: Swarm of Sarcopikes
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Cold Aura
traits.desc: At the end of each of the swarm's turns, each creature that isn't a sarcopike in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the swarm takes 4 (1d8) Cold damage.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The swarm can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Swarm of Bites
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Cold damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

traits.name: Aura of Bravery
traits.desc: Creatures of the valkyrie's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from it have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened condition while there.

traits.name: Mounted Adept
traits.desc: While mounted and without the Incapacitated condition, the valkyrie and its mount have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and the valkyrie can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the valkyrie instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The valkyrie makes three attacks, using Longsword or Radiant Javelin in any combination.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Javelin
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

reactions.name: Valorous Rebuke (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the valkyrie can see moves within 5 feet of it. Response: The valkyrie makes one Longsword attack against the creature. On a hit, the attack deals an additional 14 (4d6) Radiant damage.
